title: Localized native free induction is the integer coproduct
statement: For a finite field k₀, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, any k₀-scheme T and any A in the ordinary derived category of native adic sheaves on its geometric fibre, the cofan with point U_T I_T A and integer legs inclusion k₀ l T A n is colimiting. These are the actual localized structure and adjunction unit of [def-sf-native-weil-induction-comparison-data], using [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution].

proof.text: For each integer n form the additive orbit functor with object Free.obj F X n and morphism Free.objMap F f n. Its successor comparison is Free.objSucc. For a complex K, the termwise coprojections form a cofan of the orbit complexes with point the underlying complex of termwise free induction. Evaluation in each degree identifies it with the heart coproduct, so HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval proves it colimiting. The heart successor formula is a chain-map equation.

Apply derived_Q_preservesCoproducts to this cofan. Compose each localized successor comparison with the exact Frobenius factorization. Naturality of that factorization and the chain-map successor equation give the corresponding recurrence for the localized cofan.

The comparison from derived free induction followed by derived forgetting to the localization of termwise free induction is the composite of the two specified exact-functor factorizations. Adjunction.Localization.ε_app identifies the localized unit with the zeroth termwise coprojection. The composition and natural-isomorphism factorization equations identify the localized structure with the termwise free structure. Naturality extends both equations along the chosen representative isomorphism of an arbitrary derived object A.

An integer orbit cofan with invertible successor comparisons and the free structure recurrence is determined, up to summand isomorphisms, by its zeroth leg. Construct these isomorphisms by integer induction: forward use the successor comparisons; backward lift their composite through the fully faithful Frobenius equivalence. The recurrence proves that each summand isomorphism takes the given leg to Free.hom of the zeroth leg. The resulting isomorphism of discrete diagrams and cocones transports the colimit. Apply this to the localized cofan, transported through the normalized comparison, whose zeroth leg is the actual derived unit. This is exactly the cofan in the theorem.

theorem nativeWeil_free_coproduct
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of k₀))]
    (A : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (T ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      ((forget k₀ l T).obj ((induction k₀ l T).obj A)) (inclusion k₀ l T A)))
